title: Cross-stitch block letter monogram
subtitle: A single large letter with a decorative floral corner, in two colours on 14-count Aida
excerpt: A single large cross-stitch block letter, approximately 50 by 60 stitches, with a small floral or leaf corner detail. The letter fills most of a 12 cm square on 14-count Aida. The design works for any letter of the alphabet from the same chart; only the cross-stitch letter shape changes.
sourceNotes: Block-letter alphabets for cross-stitch are a standard category in UK needlework publishing. The decorative corner motif approach (letter plus small botanical) is widely used in beginner alphabet samplers.

content.text: A block letter monogram is one of the fastest ways to produce a personalised piece. The same chart serves all 26 letters; only the shape changes. The corner sprig, a small cluster of leaves or a single flower, keeps the square from looking blank around the large letter.

items.label: Thread
items.value: Choose your main letter colour and one green for the corner sprig — for example DMC 336 (navy) and 320 (medium pistachio), or 3685 (dark mauve) and 319 (dark pistachio)

content.text: Find the centre of the letter on the chart.
Mark the horizontal and vertical midpoints of the letter. Match to the fabric centre. Stitch the letter from the centre outward to keep counting errors small.
Fill the letter body in rows.
Work horizontal rows across the letter in your chosen colour. Block letters have thick strokes with right-angle corners; count carefully at the corners where strokes join.

Position the sprig in the lower right corner of the square. A simple sprig of three leaves and two small flowers is enough to balance the letter. Stitch the stem in back-stitch, the leaves in cross-stitch fill, and the flower dots as French knots.
A single row of back-stitch three to four stitches inside the edge of the finished piece ties the letter and sprig together.

Frame in a 12 cm square frame or display in a 12 cm hoop. Monograms work well on a white Aida background in a natural wood frame. They also make a clean personalised insert for a card blank cut to 12 × 12 cm.
